notes: SoothToken is the Sooth Protocol (SOOTH) ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its parameterless constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 SOOTH once to msg.sender, the deploying factory. Transfers have no fees. There are no administrative powers, post-deployment minting functions, or application contracts. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
